description: Complete Class 11 & 12 NCERT Chemistry chapter summaries (19 chapters).

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Mole concept (NA = 6.022×10²³), empirical & molecular formula, limiting reagent, molarity M = mol/L, molality m = mol/kg solvent (temperature independent).

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Quantum numbers (n, l, m, s), max electrons in subshell 2(2l+1), Aufbau principle, Pauli exclusion principle, Hund's rule, Heisenberg uncertainty Δx·Δp ≥ h/(4π).

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.chapter_title: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
passages.content: Periodic trends: atomic radius decreases across a period & increases down a group; ionization enthalpy & electronegativity increase across a period; F is most electronegative, Cl has highest electron gain enthalpy.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: VSEPR repulsion order lp-lp > lp-bp > bp-bp, hybridisation (sp, sp², sp³, sp³d, sp³d²), Molecular Orbital Theory bond order = (Nb - Na)/2, O2 has BO = 2 and is paramagnetic.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: First law ΔU = q + w, enthalpy ΔH = ΔU + ΔngRT, Hess's law, entropy ΔS, Gibbs free energy ΔG = ΔH - TΔS (spontaneous if ΔG < 0), ΔG° = -RT ln K.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Law of mass action Kc, Kp = Kc(RT)^Δng, Le Chatelier's principle, Brønsted-Lowry & Lewis acids/bases, pH = -log[H+], Henderson-Hasselbalch buffer equation, solubility product Ksp.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Oxidation (loss of e⁻ / increase in oxidation number), reduction (gain of e⁻), disproportionation reactions, balancing by ion-electron and oxidation number methods.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.chapter_title: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
passages.content: IUPAC nomenclature, inductive (+I/-I), resonance, electromeric, and hyperconjugation effects; carbocation stability 3° > 2° > 1° > CH3+; electrophiles vs nucleophiles.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Alkanes (Wurtz reaction, free radical halogenation), alkenes (Markovnikov & anti-Markovnikov/peroxide addition, ozonolysis), alkynes (acidic terminal H), benzene electrophilic substitution.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Henry's law p = KH x, Raoult's law p₁ = p₁° x₁, ideal solutions (ΔmixH = 0, ΔmixV = 0), colligative properties (ΔTb = i Kb m, ΔTf = i Kf m, π = iCRT), van't Hoff factor i.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Nernst equation E = E° - (0.0591/n) log Q at 298 K, ΔG° = -nFE°cell, Kohlrausch's law of independent migration of ions, Faraday's laws of electrolysis.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Rate law & order vs molecularity, zero-order t1/2 = [R]₀/(2k), first-order k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]) and t1/2 = 0.693/k (independent of [R]₀), Arrhenius equation k = A e^(-Ea/RT).

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Variable oxidation states, coloured ions (d-d transitions), spin-only magnetic moment μ = √(n(n+2)) BM, KMnO4 & K2Cr2O7 oxidizing properties, lanthanoid contraction.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Werner's theory, IUPAC naming, Valence Bond Theory, Crystal Field Theory: Δt = (4/9) Δo, spectrochemical series (CN⁻, CO strong field; I⁻, Br⁻ weak field), isomerism.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: SN2 (single step, 1° > 2° > 3°, Walden inversion) vs SN1 (carbocation, 3° > 2° > 1°, racemisation), Zaitsev elimination, Finkelstein & Swarts reactions, aryl halide low reactivity.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Lucas test (3° immediate turbidity, 2° 5 min, 1° no turbidity at RT), acidic nature of phenols, Reimer-Tiemann & Kolbe reactions, Williamson ether synthesis.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Nucleophilic addition, Tollens' reagent (ammoniacal AgNO3 silver mirror for aldehydes), Fehling's test, Aldol condensation (α-H required), Cannizzaro reaction (no α-H), HVZ reaction.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Basicity in aqueous solution (2° > 1° > 3° for methylamines), Gabriel phthalimide synthesis, Hoffmann bromamide degradation (1 carbon less), Hinsberg test, diazonium salt Sandmeyer reaction.

passages.subject: chemistry
passages.content: Carbohydrates (glucose, sucrose non-reducing, starch, cellulose), amino acids & zwitterion, peptide bond, protein structures (1°–4°), DNA vs RNA bases (T vs U), fat/water soluble vitamins.
